title: Solving modulo a power of q by an essentially smooth Artinian algebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, $\Lambda$ a Noetherian $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] which is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], $\mathfrak q\subset\Lambda$ a prime ideal, $n\ge1$ an integer and $E\subset\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ a finite subset ($\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ the localization [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]). Then there are an integer $m\ge0$ and a homomorphism of $k$-algebras $\varphi:k[y_1,\dots,y_m]\to\Lambda$ with the following properties, where $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ and $P=k[y_1,\dots,y_m]_{\mathfrak p}$: (1) $\mathfrak q\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}=\mathfrak p\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ and the induced map $P\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (2) there is a factorization $P/\mathfrak p^nP\to D\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$ of the induced map by local homomorphisms of local Artinian rings, where the first arrow is essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map] and the second is flat; (3) every element of $E$ lies in the image of $D\to\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^n\Lambda_{\mathfrak q}$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07FH (lemma-solution-modulo, line 2552), Section 07FF; its proof uses Lemma Tag 07FG (lemma-helper)
